name: archmap
description: MCP server, skill and an opt-in SessionStart hook for archmap, which maps a repository's components and dependencies (summary, query, impact, check). Requires the archmap binary on PATH, installed separately: cargo install --git https://github.com/tamatebox/archmap archmap-cli

auto_refresh.title: Refresh the work snapshot as a session starts
auto_refresh.description: Run `archmap fetch github --if-older-than` in the background when a session starts, through your gh login, for a project whose origin is on github.com. It writes .archmap/github.json, with issue and pull request titles unless the snapshot was fetched with --no-titles. Off by default.

auto_refresh_interval.title: Refresh when the snapshot is older than
auto_refresh_interval.description: A duration as archmap takes it: 30m, 2h, 1d.
